positions.name: Rivian Automotive
positions.catalyst: Q2 2026 deliveries 12,194 beat own 9-11k guide (consensus ~10.5k); raised FY26 delivery guidance to 65-70k from 62-67k on R1/EDV demand + start of R2 SUV deliveries. Needham reiterated Buy, $23 PT.
positions.driver: Fresh fundamental re-rating on delivery beat + guidance raise with R2 ramp beginning; clear upward direction. Faded from $19.79 intraday peak to ~$18.62, so entry is off the highs rather than chasing the top.
positions.risks: EV demand/margin sensitivity; high beta; 3-day holiday-weekend gap risk (mkt closed Fri 7/3, held into Mon 7/6); broad tech/growth was weak on 7/2. Hard stop 6% below entry.
